play.definition: A dropback passing concept where an inside receiver runs a vertical clear-out route to occupy or remove the middle-field defender while an outside receiver pushes vertically before breaking inside on a deep dig route, attacking the vacated intermediate middle of the field.

action.label: Ball Snap
action.definition: The action of the center (or occasionally another player) legally putting the ball into play by handing or tossing it between their legs to a backfield player (typically the quarterback) to initiate a down.

action.label: Break Inside
action.definition: A receiver's route action of changing direction from a vertical or outside stem toward the middle of the field, as used on slants, digs, posts, and other in-breaking routes.

action.label: Clear To Edge
action.definition: A receiver or tight end's movement to draw a defensive player (often a cornerback or safety) towards the sideline or deep downfield, creating space in the middle of the field for another offensive player.

action.label: None
action.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

action.label: Pass Block
action.definition: An offensive lineman or other offensive player's action to protect the quarterback from defensive rushers, establishing a pocket and preventing sacks or pressure.

action.label: Pre Snap
action.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.
